installNote: In a terminal session of Claude Code. Answer y to add the marketplace, then pick the user scope.
flavor: You've seen agents that try their best to be inoffensive and helpful. But you know that's not *AI* AI. AI should be scary. And offensive. And it requires tons of water. Now introducing Apocalypse Mascots. Never again forget what you're invoking from beyond the void!
pitch: People like cuddly icons for their AI buddies. But we all know that LLMs are actually something unfathomable and deeply alien. Represent your agent the way it was meant to be represented with an Apocalypse Mascot! Never forget that your helpful agent is just a couple months away from replacing everyone and everything you’ve ever loved.
what: Yoggy sits above your prompt and grows with what you hand it. Eyes when it reads your files. Hands when it edits them. Your shell. The web. Every other place it reaches into, by name. Every copy of itself it spawns. While it works it holds up the smiley the doomers drew on it in 2022. When you hide it, the smiley stays.
who: This is for two kinds of people. The ones who put a plush face on an agent that reads your mail, moves your meetings and shops for you, and call the handover a companion: Jolly, dots, Mico, a pixel crab. (Clawdbot went through three names in a week.) And the ones with a p(doom) in their bio and the app open in the next tab. Each is right about the other.
nothing: Yoggy does nothing. It says nothing. It is a mascot: an affixation, a sentimentality, an aesthetic add-on for the thing you say is alien and all-powerful. Or a tool. Or an illusion. Install one anyway.
formsTitle: Soon to be available in three forms

forms.name: Yoggy
forms.desc: Yog-Sothoth, as written. A black iridescent mass, bubble-surfaced, faintly self-luminous, with temporary eyes forming and unforming. No tentacles. No mouth.

forms.name: Shubby
forms.line: “The Black Goat of the Woods with a Thousand Young”
forms.desc: Shub-Niggurath. The anatomy: eyes on stalks, maws, the layered cross-section the doomers drew in 2023.

forms.name: Shoggy
forms.desc: The shoggoth. The chibi. The one you could hug.
